anchors.proseDeadline: Submissions close November 1, 2026 and are reviewed as they come in.
anchors.ship1: Smart contracts written and tested in Arc Studio and deployed to Arc mainnet
anchors.ship2: A working app built in Arc Studio that calls those contracts, live at a public link
anchors.ship3: At least one Arc mainnet transaction that moves USDC through your contract and app
needs: contract address(es) and one example transaction hash, with a link on explorer.arc.io
A video walkthrough that shows the build in Arc Studio and the mainnet transaction
A short description ... and how you used Arc Studio to build it
A public builder profile on GitHub, X, or Farcaster
anchors.notEligible: projects built outside Arc Studio, testnet-only builds, design mockups, slide decks, and work already funded by a Circle or Arc program
anchors.polish: Experiments are welcome, and polish is optional.
eligibility: worldwide subject to sanctions and restricted-jurisdiction screening
pseudonymous allowed; verification after conditional selection
must be built in Arc Studio and deployed to Arc mainnet at the time you submit
work must be yours or you must have the right to submit it
You keep full ownership of your work. No equity, no IP assignment, no exclusivity.
Program dates and microgrant counts may be adjusted.
anchors.prize: Eight microgrants of $500 USDC each, from a $4,000 USDC pool
